nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad

avis.texte: I really enjoy the way these toner pads feel. I've been using them for about two weeks now and they're my first step after I cleanse my face. They leave my face feeling cleansed and fresh and ready for all my moisturizing products. I feel like you also get a great amount of them for how much you're paying.

These pads glide so smoothly over my skin and leave my skin glowing and refreshed. I leave the pad under my eyes or anywhere i need extra moisture. This is also a great mask when applying pads on your face and leaving them for 20 minites.
Its not bad but i dont think it would work well for oily skin type. The pads stick tocether and you have to pull it apart.
Amaze, skin is already improving. Much easier than whole face masks, but works just as good.
Love this product. I smooth it over my face and then leave the pad under my eyes as a mask as I drive to work.

Love this! I leave it on my skin for 10 minutes and it feels so moisturized. I would definitely buy this again, It leaves my skin feeling so plump and nice. It gives glow as well! Feels great and doesn't irritate me. I would recommend this to anyone it is truly a great product, use as a mini sheet mask.
this product is so great, after 10 minutes of leaving on face, it feels so moisturized
I have combination skin and this toner pad makes my skin so hydrated and soft!! Definitely repurchasing!!
I love these toner pads, when my skin is irritated and feels dry this fixes it so quickly
Super hydrating, makes acne appear smaller, feels great on the skin! I use these every morning and have absolutely seen a change in my skin!

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product! I figured it was time I start incorporating new and better items into my skin care routine but I also wanted to be budget conscious. These birch wood toner pads popped up when I googled 'top toner pads of 2023' and I am so glad they did! They are so hydrating I can't believe I've waited so long to try them! I leave them on for a max of 5 minutes, and when I peel them off I squeeze the excess liquid out and pat it into my skin. I am so happy I use these and plan to make it a staple in my skincare routine for 2024. I have combination skin but this doesn't break me out, it doesn't make my oily skin greasy and it doesn't dehydrate my dry skin like micellar water does. Would absolutely recommend and I already have to many others who have purchased. 5 star product without a doubt!

I had a hard time finding moisture pads without pore clogging ingredients , and finally came upon these . They are ofc very moisturizing and did not break me out whatsoever. Great product, big fan of round lab products.
This has become an essential part of my skincare routine. As soon as I used it, I instantly fell in love. It's very soothing on my skin. I have definitely noticed an improvement in texture as well!
Excellent hydrating pads can be used as a mask to hydrate the skin!! excellent for dry skin but not only
These pads feel super moisturizing and hydrating, the same as a sheet mask but less expensive

These pads are so soft and soaked with essence. It's unbelievable. My skin like drank this essence. I have very dry skin that tends to break out when it gets too dry. I now have a super smooth solution for this problem. No break out. No make-up greasing. Love it.
the cottons are super fine and well soaked. the toner does not contain comedogenic ingredients too. also contains a spatula
Lovely set of toner pads. Pads are soft and drenched in essence, leaves my skin hydrated and plump. I love to use these as a mask

These pads are wonderful for cleansing and exfoliating the skin gently and effectively. I use them after washing my face, and they leave my skin fresh, soft and luminous. The pads have a soft, cushioned texture that does not irritate the skin. The packaging is very practical and comfortable, with a dispenser that avoids contact with air and germs. The aroma is very soft and pleasant, it doesn't bother me at all. I use them in the morning and at night, before applying my toner and moisturizer. I highly recommend them if you are looking for pads that cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate your skin. I give it five stars.
I'm honestly not the biggest fan of the sunscreen but these toner pads are great
My friend gave me some to try and I loved it!! Just ordered some and can't wait to use it.
Super moisturizing and I like that I can use it as a face mask! definitely one of the products that helped to clear my skin :)
I loved the product, if you have a quick skincare routine due to lack of time you will love this product.

I don't understand why no one is talking abt this product but I have combination and sensitive skin and this one helped me in just 2 uses to heal some of my acne and textured skin. Would definitely recommend, would definitely repurchase ^^

avis.titre: Helps my skin feel so clean
avis.texte: I love using this in my morning routine! It's easy to use and helps my skin feel so clean. I just wish the tweezers can attach to the inside of the cap like other products do. I'm afraid I'll lose them one day.
Removes makeup well, has a lot of essence for removal. Really gentle on sensitive skin and doesn't leave it dry or irritated.
It's not harsh at all and there is no strong smell with it. It takes off makeup and dirt well and is the size is much larger than expected which is great!

In the morning I usually just wash my face with water and follow with toner on a cotton pad. These cleanser pads replace the toner/cotton pad combo perfectly. It feels cleaner but moisturizing at the same time. The pads are heavily soaked with essence, so I just squeeze some of that out to prevent dripping. I highly recommend it and will definitely repurchase.
I love this cleaning pads so much. It cleans makeup easily. One pad is enough to clean whole face.
Cleansing wipes works very well. And it's also very hydrating!

I got these as a lazy cleanser on hot summer days. They are very juicy and saturated inside and hydrating but they leave my skin a bit tacky so I don't necessarily feel cleansed. I wouldn't say it removes sunscreen either, it feels more like a toner pad tbh. Overall, it's a good value but not among my favorite Round Lab products

The ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser Pad is a skincare essential I can't live without. These convenient pads are saturated with a gentle cleanser that effortlessly removes impurities while nourishing my skin with birch juice. The portable design makes them perfect for travel or quick cleansing on the go. I'm absolutely thrilled with how these pads have simplified my skincare routine and left my skin feeling clean and hydrated. A definite must-have for anyone looking for a refreshing and time-saving cleansing solution.

There was no odor or irritation, the pad was fluffy, and it was easy to use and could easily remove regular makeup. Water loop mascara cannot be removed. This is a product that I would like to repurchase.
This cleansing pad is gentle enough for my sensitive skin. This is an excellent product for quickly removing light makeup or sunscreen.

These cleansing pads are seriously the best thing EVER. I was so surprised to see how well these cleansed my skin as a first cleanser; I usually go back in with a second pad to be sure I got everything and let me tell you… the second pad is ALWAYS clean. the pads are so hydrating too! new HG!
I love these- I use them as toner pads and they're amazing. Perfect amount of moisture and hydration without being irritating!
It is already famous in Korea. Calm acne and place it on your face when you are dehydrated. It is cool.????????
Have been using this for over a month and it is so amazing. I love that the pad is really thin and brings enough moisturize to your skin. Will purchase this again!

These toner pads are very soothing and works quite well for my skin type, tends towards dry and this one works well without irritating my skin. Overall very pleased with it, priced reasonably too for the quality.

These toner pads are made with is a really lovely hydrating toner. The pads themselves are neither great not bad (mostly just forgettable), but the essence is great. It feels lightweight but immediately nourishing on the skin, preps the face well for subsequent makeup steps, and has absolutely no scent or fragrance. I fell in love with this right away, but sadly I did get a few very small red bumps from using this. I have remarkably sensitive skin so I don't expect this to be a typical experience, but if you find that botanical extracts don't agree with your skin, then this might not be for you. Other than that though, I would recommend these to all ages and skin types. It is very easy to make a quick sheet mask for dehydrated people by just placing a toner pad on areas of the face that need extra hydration and leaving them for a couple minutes before proceeding with the rest of your skincare (when I do this I use 3; one on the forehead and one on each cheek).

I love these toner pads.I used them in my 7 step daily skin care routine. Ive been using them for 1 week and they helped my skin redness around nose and on forehead. I also used a little hack: I ripped 1 pad into 2 pieces and placed them on my cheeks for 2 mins in the am and redness went away. The solution didnt cause any break outs. It kept my skin well moisturized and dewy all day. I used it twice a day. I like that the pads come well soaked in the product and dont have alcohol as component. 10/10 recommend.

avis.titre: Works well on combination sensitive skin
avis.texte: This Birch Juice moisturizing pads hydrates without feeling sticky on the skin. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated and soft. I have combination sensitive skin and this did not cause any redness, irritation or sensitivity.
Pads are super soft moisturizing! No fragrance which I love. So much lotion in the jar so you dont have to worry about drying out! I love Korean skin care and this will be added to my favorites!
Love using it after cleansing but before facial oil. Cleans face/skin before applying facial oil. Seems to calm my skin after a long day under the sun.
